title: Exit-time VUID cleanup: destroy all VkBuffer/VkImage/VkDeviceMemory in correct order
purpose: Eliminate shutdown validation errors (VUID-vkDestroyDevice-device-05137) by ensuring all child objects are destroyed/free before vkDestroyDevice.

steps.detail: Add debug-only tracking of created VkBuffer, VkImage, and VkDeviceMemory (or VMA allocations) per subsystem (mesh, volume, bloom, TAA, swapchain).

On Application::cleanup(): stop rendering, vkDeviceWaitIdle, then destroy pipelines and descriptor pools/sets/layouts, then AS (TLAS, BLAS), then destroy all remaining images, image views, buffers, and finally free memory (or call vmaDestroy*). Null handles after destroy.
Ensure TAA images (history/current), bloom images, and any volume images created are explicitly destroyed before device.
Print a compact summary of destroyed counts per resource type in debug builds (e.g., 'Destroyed: 5 images, 6 buffers, 2 memories').

acceptance: No 05137 VUIDs on three consecutive runs/shutdowns
Resource destruction summary appears once per shutdown in logs/run.txt
notes: If using VMA later, rely on vmaDestroyBuffer/vmaDestroyImage instead of raw vk*; until then, free VkDeviceMemory explicitly for manually allocated resources.
